rationale: No long-lived production private key or recovery secret is retained.
The public dward1502/Arda repository has GitHub Actions enabled.
Fulcio binds a short-lived certificate to the tag-bound workflow identity.
Rekor supplies a publicly auditable signing event.

activation_gates: Commit and push the workflow through normal repository review.
Create the production-release environment with a required maintainer reviewer.
Protect main and require review for signing-workflow changes.
Generate final normalized artifacts and publish a reviewed v* release.
Require the workflow run and all six identity-bound bundle verifications to pass before distribution.
limitations: No remote repository settings were changed and no workflow was pushed from this session.
No production OIDC signature can be generated before the workflow exists on GitHub and is triggered by a release tag.
Retained candidate-key signatures cover pre-normalization candidate bytes and are not production publisher signatures.
